lens: Component-library engineer (frozen APIs, container queries, accessible markup patterns)
reads: research/cedar-springs-teardown-blueprint.md (moved from the repo root at the seed commit)
deliverables: Every C3 primitive in COMPONENTS.md implemented with the frozen API: hero with living-scene slot, numbered section heads, spec strip, tiles, spotlight bento card, timeline, review card + reviews band, credentials row, local-rules callout with last-reviewed date, shared-regional block, guarantee, reassurance strip, FAQ <details>, living CTA band, fallback contact panel, in-page TOC
Container-query reflow at 320 px for every card/tile; paired 4x-ui-*.css files
tests/unit/ui-api.test.mjs snapshot of every export and parameter name (fails on removal; additive optional params allowed)
/styleguide/ (noindex, not in sitemap, showcase builds only) rendering every primitive in both themes
acceptance: C3.6: Component inventory — verified by unit/ui-api.test#inventory
C4.1: Content breakpoints 40/64/80em, container queries, one DOM per component — verified by check-css#breakpoints-and-cq
P1#8: Reviews band, credentials row (verifiable only), written guarantee — verified by check-honesty#reviews-credentials-guarantee
No primitive emits a heading level the caller did not choose; one H1 rule untouched
gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
verifierLens: API contract auditor: diff exports against COMPONENTS.md, axe every styleguide specimen at 320 and 1440 in both themes
portRule: builder = port; reviewer = port + 10; fixer = port + 20; evidence collector 4400
returns: {branch, head, base, files, gates, acceptance[], requests[]}
requests: .orchestra/requests/ds-comp.md (never edit a file outside owns; describe the change there)
